notes.title: Update notes for version 1,5.4
notes.notes:
• Fixed bug that would cause black balls to spawn in at the wrong size
• Fixed a bug where collision would not apply to balls that were near the edge of the canvas

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.5
notes.notes: We've just released a new update for DrawBall! This update contains various quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes  and new rewards for players who achieve all 3 stars on the title screen!

notes.title: DrawBall Demo Now Available!
notes.notes: A free demo of DrawBall is now available! Download it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822910/DrawBall/]here[/url]! The demo contains a few levels from the full game which you can play for free if you'd like to check out DrawBall before you buy it!
